amendment: Two const-PINNED_SEATS find strings occur twice in the v8 WIP (the configure() c14r99 dict and the self-test's `pinned = {...}` check at SELFTEST block). The harness fails closed (exit 2) on any find string that is not unique. Both entries are re-anchored to the configure() dict text only, by including the dict's own delimiter/terminator. Replacement text and the registered expectation are unchanged. Made after the v8 WIP bytes were first read (sha c7a9a2c2110bd8b030241b94c104259b893ca06d8f2cacd7bbf1e428f413e6af at the failed enumeration) and before any kill run; no kill outcome had been observed.
notes: del-leg entries delete the leg's decision (assignment in evaluate or checks-dict entry); one per new leg. The harness fails closed if a leg is absent from the counter or has no derived del-leg site.
mut-const entries replace one literal of the c14r99 profile; the find string must occur exactly once in the pinned counter source, else the harness exits 2 (PREREG_FAIL).

Kill expectation (predicted before any v8 run): every del-leg of a new leg is killed by the honest c14r99 self-test fixture and by the do-nothing tree. mut-const flips are expected to be killed by the self-test (v8 self-test asserts the c14r99 pins at its own check) and/or the tree detector. A mut-const that survives BOTH detectors is reported as a v8 coverage finding.
